_comment: VARIETYSTRUCTUREPLAN Band 2 (D4/§5) — layers a little raw Farmer's Delight produce (onion) onto the Overgrown Cook's Homestead's chest. Inert without Farmer's Delight: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and adds nothing when absent. Farmer's Delight has no progression gate, so this is pure flavour scrap.
